observations.title: Share explored terrain with the server group
observations.player_action: Explore terrain with matching server/client map-sync support active.
observations.outcome: The addon sends discovered map tiles so other participating players receive explored surface/cave terrain across dimensions.
conditions: Installed 2.0.1 predates the page's 2.0.4; advertised timing is not a JEM guarantee.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Only explored terrain and authoritative official discoveries may be shared in JEM. This addon does not authorize publishing native personal waypoints, homes, deathpoints, labels or settings.
